definitions.explanation: A menu item, special offer, or selection that changes every week, commonly used at restaurants and cafeterias.

examples.japanese: {週替|しゅうが}わりランチにする。
examples.english: I'll have the weekly lunch special.

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}の{週替|しゅうが}わりメニューは{何|なに}？
{週替|しゅうが}わり{定食|ていしょく}は{毎週|まいしゅう}{月曜日|げつようび}に{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The weekly set meal changes every Monday.

notes:
{週替|しゅうが}わり menus are popular at company cafeterias, family restaurants, and lunch spots. They offer variety and encourage repeat visits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週替|しゅうが}わりランチ (weekly lunch special)
- {週替|しゅうが}わり{定食|ていしょく} (weekly set meal)
- {週替|しゅうが}わりメニュー (weekly menu)

RELATED TERMS:
- {日替|ひが}わり: daily special
- {月替|つきが}わり: monthly special
- {本日|ほんじつ}の: today's (special)
